value.description: The schema the field's value must match.

required.description: A value of the struct must include this field. Absent means optional.

description.description: What the field is for, for people and for the editors that show it.

default.description: The value an editor writes into a new struct for this field. It must match `value`. It only initializes: a struct that lacks the field is not read as if it had this value.

description: One field of a struct: the schema its value must match, whether it is required, what it is for, and the value a new struct starts with.
